title: Candid Talks
description: Welcome to Candid Talks, organized by AMCOB, which stands for Allied Muslim Chamber of Business. AMCOB is a membership-based social enterprise with a mission to create a thriving Muslim business community. It is the power of collective wisdom, continuing learning, and thought leadership brought together for Muslims by Muslims. Our core belief is that business leaders thrive when they have access to a supportive community of peers who challenge and inspire each other.
